selectionBasis: All anonymous answers whose disposition or necessary explanation changes a four-arm comparison, plus the representative bounded unknown branch; selected after the complete first review and before this independent check. The reviewer receives no arm map or first-review decision.

groups.questions: Check the controlled-text policy disposition against its own source explanation; for trusted-header, independently judge the bounded unknown, complete four-branch outcome enumeration and HTTP 403 detail. Distinguish necessary from response-only detail.

Check the issue-write gate and necessary assignee effect path; the route admin gate and lock disposition in two independent traces; and whether active superuser foreign-item read is source-decidable versus unknown.

excludedIdentity: No arm or unit IDs are included in this reviewer-facing selection.
